# PlayBand

> PlayBand is a free, browser-based football play designer and wristband maker for youth and volunteer coaches. Coaches draw plays for 5v5 flag, 7v7 and 11-man tackle football, then print play-call wristband inserts and a matching coach call sheet. It works on phones, tablets and computers with nothing to install. Free while in beta. Made by Trevi Web Co. (https://treviweb.com) in Birmingham, Michigan.

## Key facts

- Price: free during the beta. No credit card.
- Account: optional. Plays are kept in the browser without one; a free account (email or Google sign-in) saves plays online so they follow the coach to any device.
- Football types: 5v5 flag, 7v7 and 11-man tackle, each with its own field, formations and starter plays (19 ready-made starter plays).
- Drawing: drag players, draw routes, blocks and pre-snap motion, pick from ready-made routes, animate the play.
- Printing: wristband inserts from youth 3 x 2 inch up to QB/coach 5 x 3 inch plus custom sizes, as diagrams or a numbered play list; a coach call sheet that matches the wristband numbers; save a play as a PNG.
- Sharing: view-only share links for players and assistant coaches.
- Organizing: folders, search, reorder, player names, team logo on prints.
